verdicts.quote: Reminders begin only after the invoice payment deadline has passed … Each invoice can have at most one accepted automatic reminder delivery
verdicts.missing: How long after the deadline the single reminder is scheduled to go out.

verdicts.quote: A fully settled invoice is ineligible for reminders … A partial payment leaves an otherwise eligible invoice eligible while a collectible balance remains … A canceled or voided invoice produces no automatic reminder
verdicts.missing: Whether a credit with a remaining balance, a dispute, or an active payment plan suspends reminders.

verdicts.quote: An otherwise eligible invoice with a positive collectible balance after partial payment can receive an automatic reminder.
verdicts.missing: Which amount the recipient sees after a partial payment, if the reminder shows an amount at all.

verdicts.quote: Once a delivery service accepts an invoice's automatic reminder, later checks, overlapping checks, or replayed work do not cause another accepted automatic reminder for that invoice.
After an invoice becomes eligible, a payment that settles it or a cancellation is recorded before the next delivery handoff. The customer receives no reminder from that handoff.

A definitively rejected temporary delivery is retried while its invoice remains eligible … the operator can determine the cause known to the service, such as a missing billing address or a temporary provider outage.
verdicts.missing: How long to wait between retries and when repeated failures trigger escalation to a person.

verdicts.quote: When more invoices qualify than a check can process, the remaining invoices are considered over subsequent checks while they remain eligible
verdicts.missing: How delivery attempts are paced against the provider's rate limit, including within a single check.

verdicts.quote: Existing eligible invoices can be reminded without being reissued. … If the eligible set exceeds the capacity of one check, work continues on later checks until it has been considered.
verdicts.missing: What limits the initial send when the entire overdue backlog fits within one check.

verdicts.quote: the invoice is not overdue at any time on that date in the billing time zone. … UTC governs a date-only due date when billing has no applicable time zone or deadline rule
verdicts.missing: Whether delivery follows the customer's local time, which hours permit sending, and how weekends and holidays affect delivery.

verdicts.quote: billing address is blank or malformed produces no automatic delivery attempt until it has a usable destination. … If a delivery service reports a bounce after accepting a reminder, the invoice's reminder outcome shows the reported delivery failure.
A reminder is addressed to the current billing email applicable to the invoice
verdicts.missing: Which recipients to use if several current billing contacts apply to the same invoice.

verdicts.quote: The operator can look up whether a reminder was accepted for delivery, skipped, rejected, or has an uncertain result for a particular invoice that was processed.
verdicts.missing: Whether the invoice displays the sent message and its send time alongside the recorded outcome.

verdicts.quote: The customer receives a reminder at the invoice's billing email address that identifies the invoice and asks for payment.
verdicts.missing: Whether the message includes the amount, due date, and a way to pay, and whether any payment link expires.

verdicts.quote: An authorized operator disables reminders for the records they manage … A manual communication previously available for an invoice can still be sent in the same circumstances after reminder activation
verdicts.missing: Whether anyone may change the schedule or manually send or stop an individual reminder, and which permissions govern those actions.

verdicts.quote: A billing operator can disable automatic reminders for their billing scope … A manual communication previously available for an invoice can still be sent in the same circumstances after reminder activation, including after an automatic reminder for that invoice.
verdicts.missing: Whether global and per-customer switches are available, how to preview or dry-run deliveries, and whether an operator can manually resend the reminder itself.

verdicts.quote: the operator can determine when an eligible invoice would normally be considered. … The operator can look up whether a reminder was accepted for delivery, skipped, rejected, or has an uncertain result
verdicts.missing: How an operator can see which specific reminders are due to go out next.

verdicts.quote: Reaching per-check capacity leaves excess work eligible for later checks
verdicts.missing: What maximum send volume applies per check or time period, or how late a reminder may still be delivered.

verdicts.quote: Reminder processing leaves existing invoice issuance rules in effect … Reminder processing leaves existing invoice update rules in effect … Customers or billing staff can make or record payments under the same existing rules with reminders active or inactive.
